This indicates that trans-Sabinyl acetate may influence the activity of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3 through the action of these compounds. The scores of 0.5627 suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though the exact mechanism remains to be determined. The evidence is consistent across two distinct paths, reinforcing the likelihood of a functional connection between trans-Sabinyl acetate and the transporter protein. The observed interactions highlight the role of these compounds in modulating the activity of the transporter, potentially affecting anion transport in macrophages.
